title: Handling Data Heterogeneity via Architectural Design for Federated Visual Recognition

layout.note: Two stacked bands joined by one fat down arrow: a blue rounded band with four dataset columns separated by dashed vertical rules, and a green dashed band with five tinted family boxes in a row, each named in bold underneath.

lesson: Tell the scope of a benchmark study in two bands: one identical mini-card per dataset showing its real statistics plus thumbnails, then one arrow to a band of model-family boxes that list their members.
